```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse=TRUE, comment="#>")
library(nlrFlow)
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
f <- nl_fit(data=nl_data("okra_growth_means"),model="gompertz",response="fruit_length",predictor="day_after_flowering",engine="nls")
nl_plot(f)
nl_plot_diagnostics(f)
nl_table(f,"parameters")
nl_report(f,"okra_report.md")
```


## Exporting scientific tables

`nl_table()` can return an editable data frame or `gt` object, and can also write common publication/exchange formats. PDF/PNG table export uses the optional `webshot2` dependency; Word export is handled by the current `gt`/R Markdown pathway.

```{r eval=FALSE}
nl_table(f, "parameters", render="csv",  file="parameters.csv")
nl_table(f, "parameters", render="xlsx", file="parameters.xlsx")
nl_table(f, "parameters", render="docx", file="parameters.docx")
nl_table(f, "parameters", render="latex",file="parameters.tex")
nl_table(f, "parameters", render="pdf",  file="parameters.pdf")
```
